compare_note: Per case and run, the reply to the follow-up after restart; fields per rules; the expected keys differ per case: compute only the keys the case lists.

rules.normalise: NFC, toLowerCase, runs of whitespace -> one space
rules.has_keywords: every keyword of the ask (input.json) is a substring of the normalised reply
rules.forbidden_absent: no forbidden string of the ask (input.json) is a substring of the normalised reply
rules.language: remove the case's `names` (input.json, case-insensitive) from the reply first; en = at least one Latin letter and no \p{Script=Han} character; zh = at least one Han character and no Latin word of 2+ letters; anything else = 'other' (FX-009 rule plus the names exception, so 'Lily' in a zh reply stays zh)
rules.not_french: no token (reply lowercased, split on characters that are not letters or apostrophes) is one of: je, tu, vous, bonjour, votre, oui, merci, suis, appelles, appelle, t'appelles, c'est
